title: How far does a wave travel?
hook: Change elapsed time and predict distance travelled.
misconception: distance travelled stays fixed when elapsed time doubles.
objective: Apply d = vt to compare distance travelled when elapsed time changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a wave packet moving at fixed speed, d = vt. When elapsed time doubles, distance travelled becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model d = vt; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a wave packet moving at fixed speed, with a nonzero initial result. If elapsed time triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on distance travelled?
recall.why: Apply d = vt under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
